title: purchaseMarketplaceItem quantity purchase: request, reply, refusal details, ledger entry
description: HolobotsMobile market-quantity-host-1 (HolobotsUnity DECISIONS #72.26, UI plan P3). Additive opt-in on the existing purchaseMarketplaceItem callable: a request carrying `quantity` buys 1-99 of ONE marketplace single item as ONE purchase; a request without `quantity` is the legacy single purchase ({itemName} -> {holosTokens, itemName, price}), unchanged byte for byte. Host-authoritative (hard rule 1): the host prices, spends, grants and refuses; clients send the request and present the reply. Validate a request with #/definitions/request and a success reply with #/definitions/reply (the Firebase callable data/result envelope is excluded). Rules: Holos spent (`price`) = `unitPrice` x `quantity` in the same users/{uid} update that raises the item counter by `quantity`; one server-only ledger entry per purchase at vendorPurchases/{uid}/marketplaceItems/{requestId} (#/definitions/receipt; rules deny clients; account deletion removes it); a retry with the same requestId replays the stored reply with alreadyProcessed true and never buys twice; the same requestId for another itemName or quantity is sequence_conflict. Stackables are every marketplace single item except the weekly Wildcard pack ('Wildcard Blueprints', quantity 1 only, 5 units, 7-day cooldown). A stackable's counter may not pass the inventory cap of 999 after the purchase. `quantity` is how many purchases of a vendor-3 listing to make; the vendor-3 listing's own `quantity` is the units ONE purchase grants (1 for every stackable). Refusals are callable errors carrying details (#/definitions/refusalDetails), checked in this order: invalid_request (no itemName: invalid-argument 'An item name is required.'; quantity not an integer 1-99, requestId missing or not ^[a-zA-Z0-9_-]{1,128}$, or any other key: invalid-argument 'A quantity purchase sends only itemName, a whole-number quantity from 1 to 99 and a request id.'), unavailable (no profile: not-found 'User profile not found.'), replay or sequence_conflict (failed-precondition 'That request id was already used for a different purchase.'), unknown_item (invalid-argument 'Unknown marketplace item.'), not_stackable (quantity above 1 on the Wildcard pack: invalid-argument 'This item is bought one at a time.'), unavailable (malformed balance, counter or pack time: failed-precondition 'Account data is unavailable.'), on_cooldown (Wildcard pack inside its 7 days: invalid-argument 'Unknown marketplace item.', the legacy message), over_cap (failed-precondition 'That would go over the most you can hold of this item.', details cap/owned/maxQuantity), not_enough_holos (failed-precondition 'Not enough Holos.', details price/holosTokens/shortfall). A refusal writes nothing. Clients key on details.rejectionCode, never on the English message.

stackableItemName.description: The items a quantity above 1 may buy (lib/marketplaceQuantity.ts MARKETPLACE_STACKABLE_ITEM_NAMES).

owned.description: The item counter after the purchase.

alreadyProcessed.description: true when this reply is the stored ledger entry's reply for a retried requestId; nothing was bought again.

refusalDetails.description: details of a quantity-path callable error. over_cap and not_enough_holos carry the host's numbers for the shortfall / max line.

maxQuantity.description: The most this pilot can buy now before the cap: cap - owned, floored at 0.

price.description: Holos the purchase would spend: unitPrice x quantity.

receipt.description: The one ledger entry per purchase: vendorPurchases/{uid}/marketplaceItems/{requestId}. Server-only (Firestore rules deny clients); documented for host tests and audits.
